name: Mienai Hoshi o Dakishimete
original_name: 見えない星を抱きしめて
source:
I don’t know how your story will end, but I know one thing for sure.

An atmospheric post-apocalyptic sci-fi visual novel where you connect via a video call—where words can’t be heard—with someone who remains on a dying planet.

Let’s stay by each other’s side until the connection is lost, searching for what lies beyond the end of the world…
translation:
我不知道你的故事会迎来怎样的结局，但唯有一件事我无比确信。

一部氛围感十足的后末日科幻视觉小说：你将通过一通听不见话语声的视频通话，与独自留在垂死星球上的某个人相连。

在信号中断之前，让我们一直陪伴在彼此身旁，一同追寻世界尽头彼岸的风景吧……
